entries.title: Factorio
entries.definitive_edition: Factorio on Windows PC with Space Age expansion

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with Space Age expansion
primary.why: The PC release supports the current Factorio base game, the Space Age expansion, modding, and the strongest keyboard/mouse and capture setup. Switch 2 also has unabridged Space Age, but PC remains the highest-fidelity and most flexible archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Factorio on Steam, GOG, or Factorio.com for Windows PC and add Factorio: Space Age for the full current content route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Space Age expansion and mod support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity capture route, complete Space Age content, and strongest mod/input support.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Mac desktop release with Space Age expansion available through PC storefront routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: same core content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support route.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Linux desktop release with Space Age expansion available through PC storefront routes.
all_releases.reason: skip: same core content family; Windows PC remains the preferred capture/support route.

all_releases.fidelity: Portable console release of the base game; Space Age is not available on the original Switch version.
all_releases.reason: skip: portable route, but incomplete for the current archive target because Space Age is not available on Switch 1.

all_releases.fidelity: Switch 2 Edition with full, unabridged Space Age content and cross-play support.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete portable/console route, but PC remains the preferred fidelity, modding, and capture platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows PC and Switch 2 both have Space Age content; PC is still the higher-fidelity and more flexible capture/mod route. The original Switch route is less complete because Space Age is not available there.

entries.remaster_caveats: Space Age is paid expansion DLC, not a separate sequel. Nintendo Switch 2 Edition is a platform upgrade/access route; the original Switch version does not include Space Age.
